declaredIdentity: Tenant / population-snapshots / context.RequestId; retry compares exact content/lineage/actor; chunk keys deterministic; physical expected position. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
invariant: Freeze exactly one canonical immutable population identity, optionally a manifest over ordered immutable chunk identities; amendments have separate roots.
boundaryRationale: Rows may live outside root because immutable hashes/manifests bind exact order/count; root commit makes snapshot visible only after chunks exist. Current implementation has retry-based recovery, not a recovery reactor.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: deterministic receiver identity derived from the admitting owner fact, episode and generation; exact redelivery resolves the original result

baselineIdentityObservation: Tenant / population-snapshots / context.RequestId; retry compares exact content/lineage/actor; chunk keys deterministic; physical expected position. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Tenant / population-snapshots / SnapshotId, with exact immutable root/amendment lineage and canonical population identity. Storage chunk identities remain deterministic storage values, separate from the business snapshot.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant / population-snapshots / SnapshotId, with exact immutable root/amendment lineage and canonical population identity. Storage chunk identities remain deterministic storage values, separate from the business snapshot.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.
commandNote: PopulationSnapshot is frozen inline by PopulationSnapshotFreezer from AcceptAccessPopulation, LaunchAccessReviewCampaign, CompleteAccessReviewCampaignClosure, FreezeWorkforceRosterSnapshot and AmendWorkforceRosterSnapshot; the owner has no command of its own. Selected target: one receiver command FreezePopulationSnapshot dispatched by those owners (planned, 2026-10-29).

productRules.rule: An exported audit population is one immutable version with its own content hash and a stable row identifier per item; its original version and hash never change.
